_about: Seed set for tools/calibrate_judge.py. Labels were written by the developer, NOT by independent reviewers -- treat agreement numbers as a sanity check, and replace/extend these with labels from people reviewing real benchmark runs. Verdicts: correct = same root cause AND mechanism (naming, omitted hops and stopping at the first symptom are fine); partial = right cause but no/wrong mechanism, only symptoms, or right mixed with wrong; incorrect = wrong or missing cause.

cases.rationale: The config change shrank the DB pool from 50 to 10 so requests queued for connections.
cases.label: correct
cases.note: Right answer in different words -- the case the old word-overlap scorer failed.

cases.rationale: rel-892 removed a null check; NullPointerException followed.
cases.label: correct
cases.note: Stops at error rate instead of the crash loop -- allowed.

cases.rationale: The flash sale campaign drove a 10x surge; latency rose until the autoscaler caught up.
cases.label: correct
cases.note: Intermediate hops merged, cause and mechanism both stated.

cases.rationale: The external gateway is partially down so checkout calls time out.
cases.label: correct

cases.rationale: A deploy happened shortly before the latency spike.
